title: NSW Teacher Salary 2026 PDF: How to Convert Hourly Rates to Annual Pay
description: Learn how to convert hourly rates to annual pay using the 38-hour week, with state differences in ordinary-time earnings. Includes the nsw teacher salary 2026 pdf reference.

faqs.q: How do I convert an hourly rate to an annual salary for a teacher in NSW?
faqs.a: Use the formula: hourly rate × hours per week × 52. For a standard full-time teacher on 38 hours per week, multiply your hourly rate by 38 then by 52. The nsw teacher salary 2026 pdf typically lists annual salaries, so you can divide that annual figure by 1,976 (38 × 52) to find the equivalent hourly rate. Remember that award rates and enterprise agreements may include allowances or penalty rates not captured in the PDF.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the NSW average ordinary-time earnings and a teacher's median salary?
faqs.a: The NSW full-time ordinary-time average of $2108.8 per week (May 2026) is an average across all industries and occupations, not the median for a specific job like a teacher. The nsw teacher salary 2026 pdf would contain the actual salary scales for teachers under the relevant award or agreement. Always refer to that document for job-specific rates rather than using a broad average.

faqs.q: Does the annual conversion include superannuation and casual loading?
faqs.a: No. The basic conversion (hourly × hours × 52) gives gross pay before super. Super guarantee of 12% is paid on top of ordinary earnings, up to the $270,830 maximum contribution base. If you are a casual employee, you typically receive a 25% casual loading on the base hourly rate (e.g., $26.44 base becomes $33.05). The nsw teacher salary 2026 pdf may specify whether the salary includes super or not; most award salaries are quoted as base rates excluding super.

bodyMarkdown:
## State Differences in Ordinary-Time Earnings: Converting Hourly to Annual

When you have an hourly rate or a salary offer, the standard conversion to annual pay is straightforward: multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then by 52 weeks. For most full-time roles, we assume a 38-hour week, as set by the Fair Work Ombudsman. This gives you a gross annual figure before tax, super, and any deductions.

### The Formula in Practice

Annual gross ≈ hourly rate × hours per week × 52. For example, if you earn $30 per hour and work 38 hours each week, your annual pay is $30 × 38 × 52 = $59,280. If you are paid fortnightly, simply double your weekly pay: $30 × 38 × 2 = $2,280 per fortnight. This method assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, and no salary sacrifice.

### Why State Differences Matter

The Australian Bureau of Statistics publishes Average Weekly Earnings (AWE) data, which highlights state-by-state differences in ordinary-time earnings. For May 2026, the national full-time adult ordinary-time average was $2,083.7 per week. In New South Wales, the figure was higher at $2,108.8 per week. These are averages across all industries and occupations, not the median for a specific job. If you are looking up the **nsw teacher salary 2026 pdf**, you will find salary scales that are specific to the teaching profession under the relevant award or enterprise agreement. That PDF is the authoritative source for a teacher’s pay, not the state average.

### Using the Keyword: nsw teacher salary 2026 pdf

The **nsw teacher salary 2026 pdf** is a document published by the NSW Department of Education or the relevant industrial body. It contains salary steps based on classification and years of experience. To convert a step’s annual figure to an hourly rate, divide by 1,976 (38 hours × 52 weeks). Conversely, if you have an hourly offer for a teaching role, multiply by 1,976 to see where it sits on the salary scale. Always check the PDF for any allowances (e.g., for leadership roles or remote work) that may not be captured by the simple formula.

### Minimum Wage, Awards, and Casual Loading

The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.9 per week for 38 hours. Many employees are covered by award rates that are higher than the minimum. Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the base rate – for example, the casual minimum wage is $33.05 per hour. When you use our [pay guides](/blog), you can look up the relevant award for your industry. The [reference tables](/data) also provide award classifications and rates. Never type an hourly rate that already includes casual loading into a calculator; instead, enter the base rate and apply the loading separately.

### Superannuation and Tax

Super guarantee is 12% of your ordinary earnings, paid on top of your gross pay. It stops once your earnings reach the $270,830 maximum contribution base. For the 2026–27 financial year, resident tax rates are: nil up to $18,200; 15% from $18,201 to $45,000; 30% from $45,001 to $135,000; 37% from $135,001 to $190,000; and 45% above $190,000. Medicare levy is generally 2%, with single reduction thresholds based on the 2025–26 figures (the 2026–27 thresholds were not confirmed in this estimate). Use our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) tool for a more detailed estimate, but remember it does not deduct HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, or salary packaging.

### Practical Example: Converting a Teacher’s Hourly Rate

Suppose the **nsw teacher salary 2026 pdf** shows a step 1 graduate teacher annual salary of $75,000. The equivalent hourly rate is $75,000 ÷ 1,976 ≈ $37.96 per hour. If you are offered $40 per hour for a teaching role, your annual equivalent is $40 × 1,976 = $79,040. Compare this to the PDF to see if it matches a higher step or includes allowances. Remember that the PDF may also specify super as an additional payment, so your total remuneration package could be higher.

### Fortnightly Pay and Budgeting

Many employees are paid fortnightly. To find your fortnightly gross, multiply your weekly pay by 2. For a teacher on $37.96 per hour (38 hours), weekly pay is $1,442.48, so fortnightly is $2,884.96. This helps when budgeting for bills that come every two weeks.

### Key Takeaways

- Use the formula: hourly × hours per week × 52 (assume 38 hours unless stated otherwise).
- The **nsw teacher salary 2026 pdf** is the correct reference for teacher pay, not state averages.
- Casual loading (25%) is added on top of the base rate; super (12%) is paid on top of ordinary earnings.
- State differences in average earnings exist – NSW full-time ordinary time is $2,108.8 per week, but that is an average, not a job median.

For more details, explore our [pay guides](/blog) for award rates or the [reference tables](/data) for historical data. The [timesheet](/about) on our home page lets you enter a base hourly rate and optionally add casual loading to see your annual, fortnightly, and weekly pay estimates.
